text:
jordan: quick FYI ran into a reproducible 'phase jitter' when onboarding redwood-13b-int8-fused on long prompts (~22k tokens). output inserts a stray comma/newline pair every ~2k tokens then recovers. float16 doesn't show it.

pei: can you paste a tiny repro and any logs? does it correlate with RoPE rescale or pack?

jordan: repro below. model uses rescaled RoPE + packed phase table. disabling packing removes jitter.

```
# local repro
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-int8-packed","input":"<22k-prompt>"}' | jq .out[19800:19840]
```

samir: logs? metric traces?

jordan: log snippet: 
```
[2026-09-02T08:11:12Z] INFO decode tok=19798 phase_raw=0.9978
[2026-09-02T08:11:12Z] INFO decode tok=19799 phase_raw=0.9978
[2026-09-02T08:11:13Z] INFO decode tok=19800 phase_raw=0.0041   # abrupt low-phase
[2026-09-02T08:11:13Z] WARN rope: phase_jitter token=19800 delta_phase=-0.9937
```

pei: unusual. packing appears to quantize the fractional multiplier and for certain offsets the rounding pushes phase across the wrap boundary. could be compounded by quantized layer scaling using fp16 accumulators.

samir: experiment: recompute phases in 32->64-bit fixed-point before packing; also try higher precision accumulator for the attention score. what are perf hits?

jordan: quick local test: computing packed entries from a 64-bit fixed-point precompute removed the jitter; cost about +0.9% throughput on short runs. using fp32 accum only for longctx runs cost ~1.1%.

ci-bot: build 2026.09.02-quantpack-run completed  tests: 228 passed, 3 flaky (longctx).

pei: sounds like a guarded fix: use fixed-point precompute when MAX_CTX exceeds threshold, and allow a telemetry counter rope.phase_jitter_total. add longctx-quant nightly that runs to 30k tokens.

samir: also add a small fuzz that randomizes pad_left and interleaved short messages to try and trigger cross-shard rounding.

jordan: opening PR with guarded fixed-point precompute, fuzz test, telemetry, and a short perf report. will tag @oncall-ml. staging long-run scheduled post CI. :thumbsup:

ops: noted; will enable the telemetry alert in staging and capture traces if the metric fires.

pei: nice scope. please include the minimal repro script and a small diff showing the precompute change in the PR. thanks.
